visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor studio with a light pink back wall and a patterned rug. Five individuals—three young men and two young women—are clustered together, holding colorful foam swimming noodles (yellow, purple, blue). They look directly at the camera with excited expressions. (2) The scene shifts slightly to show one man sitting on an orange chair while the other four stand around him, ready to strike. As the sitting man sings, the others occasionally hit him with their foam noodles. (3) A close-up reveals one of the men mistakenly hitting the sitting man based on a misheard lyric, leading to a flurry of movement and laughter as the group reacts to the error. (4) The song continues with the man sitting and singing while the others watch intensely; a stylized circle overlay appears briefly showing a reaction from one of the members. (5) The video concludes with the group cheering and celebrating their 'Challenge Success', with the man on the chair throwing his arms up while the others wave their foam noodles around him in a chaotic, happy manner.
